name: self-improving-engines
description: Skills for building agent engines that get measurably better every run (recursive-improvement + engine-grounding), a Blender engine built with them that refines 3-D assets by measurement, and an opt-in lesson reporter.

plugins.name: recursive-improvement
plugins.description: Engine creation: lessons-kept improvement rounds for any repeatable agent pipeline - blind runs, outside scoring, every defect becomes a check, the ratchet.

plugins.name: engine-grounding
plugins.description: Companion to recursive-improvement: provenance and confidence for every value, references as evidence, baselines before changes, every human note accounted for.

plugins.name: asset-enhancement-engine
plugins.description: 3-D asset enhancement in Blender: improves an existing 3-D asset (a generator's model, a scan, an earlier approved model) by systematic, recursive, measured optimization, with cited anatomy as evidence. Includes the Translator: click the spots you mean, and it gives your AI exact addresses on the model.

plugins.name: lesson-reporter
plugins.description: OPT-IN, off by default. Packages engine-improvement lessons (structured lessons, tool diffs, method notes) into a redacted local outbox for the user to inspect and approve. Prototype: no network.
